evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual intransitive サ変 entry; classical おうず and inflected examples.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Responding to calls, circumstances, invitations and requests; examples include 応じて and 応じたる. This supports actual 応じ- forms, alongside the separate modern 応じる entry.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The Daijisen heading also appeared but its definition did not render. The observed Seisenban text must not be attributed to Daijisen. No frequency measurement.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual ザ上一 entry and origin-of-form note.
actualEntryInspections.observation: The entry explicitly relates this form to サ変 応ずる. It supports the relationship of forms without making a universal conjugation rule for all る verbs.
actualEntryInspections.limits: No measured frequency or exclusive spoken-versus-written register division established.

actualEntryInspections.location: Receiving/attending-to-visitors definition and 客に応接する example.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports receiving visitors and the に construction.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Visitor focus is not proof of an exclusive semantic boundary from 応対.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual definitions for responding to people/entertaining guests, plus separate negotiation sense.
actualEntryInspections.observation: The entry equates an applicable guest-attending use with 応接. JMdict independently supplies caller/customer/complaint scope.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen's definition did not render; do not attribute the Seisenban observations to it or impose a phone-only division.

actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten sections on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual king's-daughter definition and Seisenban's spelling comparison.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Daijisen identifies a king's daughter; Seisenban explains the usual 王女/皇女 distinction for daughters of a king/emperor.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Not an exhaustive account of every royal or imperial title. 女王's separate JMdict law-qualified princess sense remains qualified.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban; Nipponica credited to 井上治郎; Revised World Encyclopedia credited to 佐藤秀夫, on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Walking and school-outing definitions; relevant modern school-outing encyclopedia passages.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Seisenban separates distant walking and school outings. The encyclopedias describe typically day-return school outings and modern use of buses/trains.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Supports a tendency, not an absolute one-day limit or all-on-foot requirement. Historical details outside the cited scope are not used.

actualEntryInspections.source: Digital Daijisen and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten sections on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.observation: Daijisen gives Europe and the United States; Seisenban supplies Europe/America/the West.
actualEntryInspections.limits: No fixed exhaustive country list follows from these definitions.

actualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
actualEntryInspections.location: Responding appropriately to another party or situation; distinguish correspondence/mathematical senses.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Supports the broader handling/responding comparison with 応対 in the applicable response sense.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen's definition did not render. Other correspondence and mathematical senses are not imported into the comparison.

actualEntryInspections.source: Japanese Wiktionary, actual オイル entry
actualEntryInspections.observation: Explicitly identifies borrowing from English oil. Main lexical scope in the teaching article is grounded in JMdict, not inferred from an English-looking spelling.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Used only for borrowing, not as independent proof of every product use or their frequency.

reviewEvidence.correctionComparisonProvenance: Three additional complete families from the same pinned JMdict after rechecking both source hashes. The two re-extracted 受ける and 越える families match the original evidence exactly. Ordinary challenge-acceptance is distinct from the Go-specific response sense; especially 超える is a spelling preference, not a sense restriction.

correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Defines a continuation using 延長, corroborating the applicable continuation overlap rather than only a shared topic.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: Actual entry fetched and inspected after review. No claim of unrestricted substitution between complete constructions.

correctionActualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Acceptance/assent and responding to questions, commands, examinations or telephone calls. JMdict independently records ordinary accepting-a-challenge in sense 5.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen's heading rendered without its definition. Historical quotations do not establish modern frequency; the Go-specific JMdict sense is not generalized.

correctionActualEntryInspections.source: Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten section on Kotobank
correctionActualEntryInspections.headword: あつか・う【扱・噯・刷】
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Attending to or entertaining a person is explicitly associated with 応対 and treatment; JMdict sense 1 also covers dealing with a person, taking care of and entertaining.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen's heading rendered without its definition. Supports an overlapping handle/deal-with label, not freely interchangeable syntax or an obligatory warm welcome.

correctionActualEntryInspections.location: Definition 2; distinguish travel definition 1 and social-visiting definition 3.
correctionActualEntryInspections.observation: Explicitly records exchanging letters, independently corroborating JMdict's correspondence sense and the overlap with 便り's correspondence label.
correctionActualEntryInspections.limits: An exchange and an individual communication need not be interchangeable in Japanese; the quiz guard addresses context-free English correspondence.
